text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate and raw-log leak potential for tenant northstar-bank in dedicated-pool-3. Incident INC-2026-1134 created. Pager: maria (oncall). Possible unredacted PII in recent logs.

maria (oncall): ack, I'm on it. Pulling latest logs from pool-3.

jake (eng-sre): joining. quick check: redaction pipeline for tenant override appears to have been bypassed by a config key change in last deploy. seeing raw emails in logs.

maria (oncall): customer on call (Northstar Bank) is asking for the raw logs for their legal review, urgent. Sam are you with them?

sam (customer-success): yes, they're asking for immediate access. They claim it's for a regulator triage. They asked if we can give them exported logs now.

anita (legal): do NOT share unredacted logs. We need to follow minimization: provide redacted extracts by default. If regulator demands raw, we need formal legal process (subpoena/consent) and internal sign-off. Ask customer to specify exact timeframe and fields required.

jake (eng-sre): we can run a one-off redaction pass and create a bundle. proposed command:```
./tools/redact --tenant northstar-bank --since "2026-03-14T02:00Z" --until "2026-03-14T04:30Z" --fields email,ssn,ccnum --mask-method hash --output /tmp/northstar_redacted.tar.gz
```

maria (oncall): starting redaction-pass now. ETA ~12m. Will confirm counts.

devops-bot: Deploy #4578 rolled out to dedicated-pool-3 at 2026-03-14T01:58Z (user: jake). Noted config override: tenant_pipeline.redact=false for northstar-bank.

jake (eng-sre): root cause: accidental tenant-specific override in the deploy manifest. Pushing fix to canary now, will roll to pool-3 after smoke.

anita (legal): customer said they have a DPA, but that alone doesn't let us disclose unredacted PII. We need: (1) written customer consent for disclosure of unredacted logs OR (2) regulator subpoena. Otherwise provide redacted bundle and a hashed mapping table if necessary. Also require a secure transfer mechanism and audit trail.

sam (customer-success): Northstar insists regulator will not wait for legal to draft addendum. They want a bundle now. They offered to sign an emergency access form.

anita (legal): emergency access form is OK as interim but must include indemnity and limit scope. I'll draft. Also require that we never share the salt used for hashing.

ops-privsec: Created ticket RG-7890 to request temporary retention extension (7 days) on pool-3 log store for tenant northstar-bank to support forensic validation. CISO approval required.

jake (eng-sre): redaction-pass finished. Summary (snippet):```
Processed: 1,248,732 lines
Matched email patterns: 4,212
Matched SSN patterns: 18
Masked and hashed identifiers: sha256(salt+value)
Output: /s3/internal/incidents/northstar/INC-2026-1134/northstar_redacted.tar.gz
```

maria (oncall): uploaded to internal S3 path. Generating presigned URL with 24h expiry per legal.

jake (eng-sre): presigned URL generated (internal record): s3://redwood-incidents/northstar/INC-2026-1134/northstar_redacted.tar.gz?presigned=true&exp=24h

anita (legal): 24h expiry is fine. Required controls before sharing: (a) customer must confirm they will not redistribute, (b) we must log IPs that download and keep audit trail, (c) include minimal metadata only. I'll attach emergency access form now.

sam (customer-success): sending the bundle to the customer's security contact via Pax or our secure share. Not sharing via email. Also requested their signed emergency form; they say they'll sign within the hour.

fiona (vp-legal): looping in VP Legal. If regulator provides formal demand, escalate to me immediately. If customer refuses to sign emergency form and insists on raw, do not share. We can provide hashed mapping keyed to a salted digest, but salt must remain internal.

ops-privsec: CISO notified for RG-7890 retention override. Also created access log job to capture downloads for the package and wrote audit entry INC-2026-1134-AUDIT.

jake (eng-sre): redaction details: free-text fields had inline emails; we applied regex: `[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}` and masked with `email:[sha256(salt+value)]`. Credit-card/SSN patterns masked similarly. Did not redact tokens or API keys yet; scanning for key patterns now.

anita (legal): Good. Ensure any API keys are rotated if found in unredacted logs. Also record retention override justification in RG-7890.

maria (oncall): customer confirmed receipt of presigned link and said their legal team will review. They signed emergency access form (attached to ticket). Sam, please confirm signed copy is saved to RG-7890.

sam (customer-success): signed form uploaded to RG-7890 and attached to the incident. Shared presigned link via secure channel. Included note: 24h expiry, download logs will be recorded.

fiona (vp-legal): confirm: do not share raw, unredacted logs outside of subpoena or explicit signed consent naming Redwood. If regulator insists and provides lawful basis, we'll coordinate a controlled handover with our legal and customer's counsel.

jake (eng-sre): ran final scan, no API keys in the redacted bundle. Rotated two service tokens that were present in unredacted logs; secrets team notified (SECRETS-4421).

maria (oncall): mitigation applied: rolled back offending config to enforce tenant redaction pipeline. Monitoring for errors; error rate back to normal within ~6 minutes of rollback.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1134 status: MITIGATED. Monitoring period: 24h.

maria (oncall): follow-up: scheduled post-incident sync tomorrow 09:00 PST with SRE, Legal, CS, and Northstar. Closing live coordination here. If regulator/legal demand appears, reopen and escalate.

anita (legal): saving notes to legal vault and incident packet. Filing for potential future audit: include redaction script, hash algorithm, and proof of customer consent.

ops-privsec: audit entry INC-2026-1134-AUDIT: presigned URL accessed 1 time by IP 54.210.11.23 at 2026-03-14T03:12:09Z (customer security team). Logged retention override RG-7890 pending CISO approval.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. closing thread for live mitigation. Will reopen if anything new shows up. :white_check_mark:
